answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialogue systems require high semantic fidelity of the generated responses ... their natural language generation (NLG) components are typically conditioned on structured input data, performing data-to-text generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our trained models performance with the standard NLG metrics BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr, whose calculation is detailed in Appendix A.4.

answer_4.quote: In a human evaluation we establish that its performance is nearly perfect for all three datasets used for testing our models (see Section 4.1). We then have one of the authors and an additional expert annotator manually label all of the errors as true or false positives.
answer_4.guideline: human annotators manually labeled all of the errors as true or false positives.
